data.long_meaning: Brya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Brihati', which is the name of a goddess associated with rain and the moon. The name carries the blessings of these celestial beings and is believed to bring prosperity and abundance. The name Brya carries the meaning “Goddess of Rain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Brya usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of rain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
